title: SWAP5 WOFOST81 Migration Preservation
architecture_decision: Use a separate wofost81_crop_owner_state_t containing the unchanged legacy wofost_crop_owner_state_t plus the qualified WOFOST81 N owner. This supersedes the earlier tentative plan to add optional WOFOST81 fields directly to the legacy owner and reduces legacy compile/runtime risk.
scientific_interpretation: The WOFOST81 versioned state boundary now exists without modifying legacy owner semantics. The next risk boundary is process composition: assimilation must consume the version-81 leaf-N state and the N request/apply path must mutate only a candidate composite owner until an accepted crop-day commit.
next_permitted_action: Create a testable WOFOST81 accepted-day candidate composition around wofost81_crop_owner_state_t. Use explicit external water/N supply inputs, source-faithful assimilation and N kernels, and candidate-only mutation. Qualify rollback/rejected-candidate isolation before wiring any runtime route or running the ten-case full-season gate.
exclusions: no replacement of existing legacy WOFOST path
